field.label: Enable pf-aliasd
field.help: Run the pf-aliasd daemon (listens on the socket below, writes to pf tables).

field.label: Socket path
field.help: Unix socket shared by pf-aliasd and the mosdns pf_alias plugin.

field.label: Flush tables on start
field.help: Comma separated pf tables to empty when pf-aliasd starts. Empty means keep.
